# Writer's Digest

> Writer's Digest is the comprehensive resource for writers of all levels, offering craft guides, publishing advice, competitions, events, and inspiration across fiction, nonfiction, and poetry.

Writer's Digest provides an extensive collection of writing guides, competitions, conferences, and resources designed to help writers improve their craft and navigate the publishing industry. The site features contributions from established authors, literary agents, and writing experts like Robert Lee Brewer and Amy Jones.

## Key Topics

- Fiction writing
- Nonfiction writing
- Poetry prompts
- Character development
- Writing craft
- Literary agents
- Publishing advice
- Author interviews
- Self-publishing
- Author branding
- Query letters
- Writing resources
- Editing and revising
- Writing guides
- Creative writing

## Writing Guides & Craft

- [Write Better Fiction](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-fiction): Comprehensive fiction writing guide covering character development, dialogue, plot, grammar, and scenes.
- [Write Better Nonfiction](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-nonfiction): Nonfiction writing guide covering memoir, articles, business books, and creative nonfiction.
- [Write Better Poetry](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-poetry): Poetry guide featuring prompts, poetic forms, and Poem-A-Day challenges.
- [Mystery/Thriller Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-fiction/genre/mysteries-and-thrillers): Mystery and thriller genre writing guide with craft tips and interviews.

## Publishing & Platform Building

- [Get Published](https://www.writersdigest.com/getting-published): Publishing guide covering literary agents, query letters, and author platforms.
- [Marketing Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/getting-published/build-my-platform/marketing): Author marketing and platform building strategies and branding tips.
- [6 Proven Tips to Build an Author Brand Readers Love and Remember](https://www.writersdigest.com/6-proven-tips-to-build-an-author-brand-readers-love-and-remember): Author branding strategies from Arizona writers including Crafty Chica creator.
- [Agent in Your Pocket: You Don't Need to Be Confident But You Do Need to Be Clear](https://www.writersdigest.com/agent-in-your-pocket-be-confident-be-clear): Literary agent Jessica Berg offers advice on pitching books clearly and confidently.

## Competitions & Events

- [WD Competitions](https://www.writersdigest.com/wd-competitions): Writer's Digest competitions including Self-Published Book Awards, Poetry Awards, and writing contests.
- [WD Events](https://www.writersdigest.com/wd-events): Writer's Digest events including conferences, writing tours, and retreats in locations like Tuscany.

## Inspiration & Prompts

- [Be Inspired](https://www.writersdigest.com/be-inspired): Inspiration hub with prompts, author interviews, and book recommendations.
- [Wednesday Poetry Prompts Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-poetry/poetry-prompts/wednesday-poetry-prompts): Archive of Wednesday poetry prompts and creative writing exercises by Robert Lee Brewer.
- [Wednesday Poetry Prompts: 778](https://www.writersdigest.com/wednesday-poetry-prompts-778): Weekly poetry prompt #778 from Robert Lee Brewer with example poem and writing exercise.

## Author Interviews & Recommendations

- [E.A. Jackson: Writing This Book Was My Own Choice](https://www.writersdigest.com/e-a-jackson-writing-this-book-was-my-own-choice): Author interview with E.A. Jackson discussing her thriller 'Missing' and writing process.
- [Kaelynn Partlow: Writing Is the Easy Part](https://www.writersdigest.com/kaelynn-partlow-writing-is-the-easy-part): Author interview with Kaelynn Partlow on publishing process and autism advocacy writing.
- [Family Drama: 9 Book Recommendations for Writing Fiction About Families](https://www.writersdigest.com/family-drama-book-recommendations-writing-fiction-about-families): Book recommendations for writing family drama fiction from WD Editor-in-Chief Amy Jones.

## Resources & Media

- [Resources Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/resources): Resources archive with guides, podcasts, and screenwriting materials.
- [WD Podcasts Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/resources/podcasts): Podcast archive featuring author interviews and writing craft discussions.

## Optional

- [Writer's Digest March/April 2026 Cover Reveal](https://www.writersdigest.com/writers-digest-march-april-2026-cover-reveal): Cover reveal for March/April 2026 issue featuring Lauren Groff interview and pacing guide.
